title: Decision Tree & Random Forest from Scratch
blurb: Grow trees with Gini impurity and combine them into a random forest.
brief: Implement a decision tree classifier (Gini or entropy, threshold search, depth and leaf-size limits), then a random forest with bootstrap sampling and random feature subsets. Compare a single tree, your forest and scikit-learn's forest on a dataset, show the overfitting gap of a deep tree, and compute feature importances.
requirements: A tree-node structure and a recursive tree builder
Gini impurity or entropy with a best-split search over feature thresholds
Stopping rules: max depth and minimum samples per leaf
Random forest with bootstrap samples and a random feature subset per split
deliverables: Tree and forest modules with a fit/predict interface
A comparison of train vs test accuracy for different depths
resume_bullet: Implemented decision trees and random forests from scratch (Gini splits, bagging, feature subsampling) and benchmarked them against scikit-learn.
